title: Australian frog species hit by chytrid fungus vs untouched (count)

source.name: Amphibian fungal panzootic causes catastrophic and ongoing loss of biodiversity (Scheele et al. 2019)

notes: Of Australia's roughly 240 native amphibian species, 40 are believed to have suffered declines from chytrid fungus, 7 of those presumed extinct. 240 - 40 = 200 not known to be affected.
